about: How often a visa is refused, researched November 14, 2026. A visitor visa's chance of refusal is the published refusal rate for the passport applying, where one is recorded; else the destination's overall rate; else the game's estimate, said as one. A work visa's is anchored to the published approval rate of the United States' O-1 and moved by the record the applicant brings (papers.ts `refusalChance`). The official State Department table refused automated download (HTTP 403), so its figures are taken as quoted by the sources named, each kept with its source.
